units.title: Present Perfect Continuous: I've been working
units.shortDescription: Длительный процесс, который ещё идёт (или только что кончился).
units.theoryHtml:
Формула: have/has been + -ing. Два главных употребления:

СлучайПример
действие длится до сих порI have been living here for ten years. (и живу)
действие длилось, и виден результат/усталостьI'm tired — I have been digging all morning.

vs Present Perfect: I've painted the kitchen (готово — результат). I've been painting the kitchen (процесс, может, ещё не закончен — одежда в краске!).

How long...? — классический вопрос к PPContinuous: How long have you been waiting?

⚠ Частые ошибки: I am living here since 2019 → I have been living here since 2019. I've been knowing him → I've known him (know — статьевый). How long are you waiting? → have you been waiting.

Мини-диалог:
— You look exhausted! — I have been working in the garden since dawn.
— How long have you been growing tomatoes? — Three years. And I have grown about a hundred!

exercises.prompt: I ___ English for five years.
exercises.explanation: Длится до сих пор — have been studying.

exercises.prompt: She's tired because she ___ all day.
How long ___ you ___ for me?
The kitchen smells great! — Yes, I ___ a cake.
I ___ this book since Monday, but I haven't finished it.
It ___ since morning. (дождь идёт)
Choose the correct sentence:
options: I've been knowing him for years.
I've been knowing him since years.
I am knowing him for years.

exercises.prompt: We ___ for two hours — let's have a break.
He ___ ___ ___ (работает) here since 2020. (has been working)
Why are your hands dirty? — I ___ ___ ___ (чинил) the bike. (fix)

units.title: Past Perfect Continuous: I had been waiting
units.shortDescription: Длинное действие ДО другого события в прошлом.
units.theoryHtml:
Формула: had been + -ing. Показывает длительное действие, которое шло ДО другого момента в прошлом: I had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally arrived (ждал час — потом пришёл автобус).

СитуацияПример
причина прошлого результатаHe was tired because he had been working all night.
фон для прошлого событияThey had been playing for an hour when it started to rain.
с for/sinceShe had been teaching for 20 years before she retired.

vs Past Perfect: I had finished the report (результат/факт) vs I had been finishing the report for hours (процесс — редкий случай; обычно had been + действие процесса: working, waiting, living).

⚠ Частые ошибки: I had waiting → had been waiting. Статьевые глаголы: I had been knowing → I had known.

Мини-диалог:
— Why were you so wet? — It had been raining for hours before the sun came out. I had been walking in it.
— How long had you been standing there? — Twenty minutes at least!

exercises.prompt: He was tired because he ___ all night.
exercises.explanation: Долго ДО прошлого события — had been working.

exercises.prompt: We ___ for an hour when the train came.
exercises.explanation: До пришёл автобус — had been waiting.

exercises.prompt: She ___ there for ten years before she moved.
The ground was wet. It ___.
exercises.explanation: Причина в прошлом — had been raining.

exercises.prompt: How long ___ you ___ before you passed?
exercises.explanation: До прошедшего результата — had been trying.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct sentence:
options: I had been knowing her for years.

I had knowing her for years.
I have been knowing her before.

exercises.prompt: The players were exhausted — they ___ for two hours.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: She had waiting for an hour.

exercises.prompt: I ___ ___ ___ (жил) abroad for years before I returned. (had been living)
They ___ ___ ___ (спорили) for hours when I arrived. (argue)

units.title: Порядок наречий: manner-place-time
units.shortDescription: I went there quickly yesterday — как расставить обстоятельства.
units.theoryHtml:
Обстоятельства идут в порядке MPT: manner (как) → place (где) → time (когда): She sang beautifully at the concert last night.

ЭлементПример
Как (manner)quickly, carefully, well
Где (place)at home, to the office, there
Когда (time)yesterday, at 5 pm, last week

Время можно вынести в начало для акцента: Yesterday, I went to the dentist.

⚠ Частые ошибки: I went yesterday to the cinema → I went to the cinema yesterday. She speaks very well English → She speaks English very well (well — в конец!).

Мини-диалог:
— When did you move? — I moved here quietly last spring.
— And you're happily living there now? — Very!

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct order:
options: I saw him yesterday in the park quickly.
I saw him quickly in the park yesterday.
I quickly saw yesterday him in the park.
I saw quickly him yesterday in the park.

exercises.prompt: She speaks English ___.
___, I met my future wife.
exercises.explanation: manner (quietly) → place → time; акцент: время можно в начало.

exercises.prompt: He drives ___.
Choose the correct sentence:
options: They arrived at 6 pm at the airport quietly.
They arrived quietly at the airport at 6 pm.
